fields.name: Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max - 256GB Natural Titanium
fields.description: iPhone 16 Pro Max. Crafted with Grade 5 titanium, featuring a new refined micro-blasted finish. Ceramic Shield front is 2x tougher than any smartphone glass. Super Retina XDR display with ProMotion up to 120Hz. A18 Pro chip powers unprecedented graphic performance and battery life for ultimate luxury power users.
fields.short_description: Featuring aerospace-grade titanium design, Camera Control, 4K 120 fps Dolby Vision, and the revolutionary A18 Pro chip.

fields.name: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra 5G - Titanium Obsidian
fields.description: Meet Galaxy S25 Ultra, the pinnacle of Samsung engineering. Designed with titanium framing and flattened display edges for an immersive viewing experience. Real-time Galaxy AI brings multi-lingual live translations, advanced photo editing, and Circle to Search.
fields.short_description: 200MP Quad Telephoto Camera, integrated S-Pen, Snapdragon 8 Elite Mobile Platform, and anti-reflective Corning Gorilla Armor glass.

fields.name: Google Pixel 9 Pro XL - Porcelain 256GB
fields.description: The all-new Google Pixel 9 Pro XL features a silky matte glass back and polished metal frame with dual-finish camera bar. Includes 7 years of Pixel Feature Drops and OS updates. Unbeatable computational photography with 30x Super Res Zoom.
fields.short_description: Tensor G4 processor with 16GB RAM, Super Actua display, and Gemini Nano AI deeply integrated across camera and voice.

fields.name: Apple MacBook Pro 16-inch M4 Max - Space Black
fields.description: Built for extreme workflows, 3D rendering, machine learning models, and 8K ProRes video grading. The M4 Max chip features hardware-accelerated ray tracing and breakthrough unified memory architecture. Space Black anodization dramatically reduces fingerprints.
fields.short_description: 16-core CPU, 40-core GPU, 36GB Unified Memory, Liquid Retina XDR with Nano-Texture glass, up to 24 hours battery life.

fields.name: Dell XPS 16 OLED InfinityEdge Workstation - Platinum
fields.description: Crafted with CNC-machined aluminum and Gorilla Glass 3. The tone-on-tone minimalist interior features a capacitive touch function row and zero-lattice keyboard for a truly futuristic typing and creator experience.
fields.short_description: Intel Core Ultra 9, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070, 4K+ OLED Touchscreen, seamless glass haptic touchpad.

fields.name: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G16 OLED Gaming Laptop
fields.description: Impossibly thin yet uncompromisingly powerful. Features NVIDIA Ada Lovelace graphics with DLSS 3.5, liquid metal thermal cooling, and dual vapor chamber for whisper-quiet high frame-rate productivity and gaming.
fields.short_description: Ultra-thin CNC aluminum chassis, 2.5K 240Hz OLED ROG Nebula display, Slash Lighting programmable lid.

fields.name: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Noise-Canceling Headphones
fields.description: Magnificent sound engineered to perfection. Specially developed 30mm carbon fiber composite driver unit enhances high-frequency sensitivity for natural sound quality. Soft-fit leather ensures cloud-like all-day listening comfort.
fields.short_description: Industry-leading noise cancelation with two processors and 8 microphones. Hi-Res Audio Wireless and 30-hour battery life.

fields.name: Bang & Olufsen Beoplay H95 Studio Edition
fields.description: Designed for 95 years of acoustic heritage. Masterfully tuned by B&O acoustic engineers to deliver sound that moves you. Foldable design with an aluminum carrying case lined with matching woven fabric.
fields.short_description: Custom titanium drivers, lambskin ear cushions, tactile aluminum dials, and adaptive active noise cancellation.

fields.name: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds - White Smoke
fields.description: Spatial audio brings what you hear right in front of you. CustomTune technology automatically adapts the noise cancellation and sound performance to your specific ears for personalized perfection.
fields.short_description: Breakthrough Bose Immersive Audio spatial sound, CustomTune sound personalization, and world-class quiet.

fields.name: Apple Watch Ultra 2 - 49mm Titanium Ocean Band
fields.description: The most capable and rugged Apple Watch ever. Features the breakthrough S9 SiP with Double Tap gesture control, on-device Siri, and precision modular watch faces built for endurance and adventure.
fields.short_description: Rugged aerospace titanium case, 3000-nit display, dual-frequency GPS, 36-hour battery, water-resistant 100m.

fields.name: Garmin Fenix 7X Pro Sapphire Solar Edition
fields.description: Conquer every hour with advanced training metrics, 24/7 health and wellness monitoring, TopoActive multi-continent maps, and titanium bezel tested to U.S. military standards for thermal and shock resistance.
fields.short_description: Solar charging power glass lens, built-in LED flashlight, multi-band GNSS satIQ, up to 37 days in smartwatch mode.

fields.name: TAG Heuer Connected Calibre E4 - 45mm Black Titanium
fields.description: The ultimate expression of luxury and digital performance. Features high-definition OLED display, golf edition GPS tracking, and heritage mechanical watch face complications inspired by legendary Carrera chronographs.
fields.short_description: Swiss luxury smartwatch craftsmanship with sapphire crystal, DLC titanium grade 2, and exclusive sports app.

fields.name: Dyson Solarcycle Morph Desk Light - Matte Black
fields.description: Engineered to reduce eyestrain and transform your workspace. 3-Point Revolute motion allows 360-degree positioning. Light quality lasts 60 years thanks to pioneering heat pipe cooling technology.
fields.short_description: Intelligently tracks local daylight. 4 lights in 1: Task, Indirect, Feature, and Ambient lamp with Heat Pipe cooling.

fields.name: Keychron Q1 Pro Wireless Custom Mechanical Keyboard
fields.description: A masterclass in tactile luxury. Connects with up to 3 devices wirelessly via Bluetooth 5.1. Features sound-absorbing foams, KSA double-shot PBT keycaps, and south-facing RGB lighting for unmatched typing satisfaction.
fields.short_description: Full CNC machined aluminum body, double-gasket acoustic dampening, hot-swappable switches, QMK/VIA programmable.

fields.name: Sony Alpha A7R V Mirrorless Camera Body
fields.description: Revolutionary AI autofocus identifies humans, animals, insects, cars, and airplanes. 8K 24p and 4K 60p video recording with 15+ stops of dynamic range. Dual CFexpress Type A / SD UHS-II card slots in magnesium-alloy weather-sealed body.
fields.short_description: 61.0MP Full-Frame Exmor R sensor, Dedicated AI processing unit for autofocus tracking, 8-stop image stabilization.

fields.name: Canon RF 50mm f/1.2L USM Prime Lens
fields.description: Setting new benchmarks in optical clarity, sharpness, and creamy background bokeh. Designed with dust and weather-resistant seals for uncompromising professional commercial and portrait production.
fields.short_description: Legendary L-series optics with ultra-fast f/1.2 aperture, Air Sphere Coating, and ring-type ultrasonic motor.

fields.name: NEXUS Cyberpunk Oversized Heavyweight Hoodie
fields.description: Designed for uncompromising comfort and contemporary street luxury. Crafted from certified 480 GSM organic French Terry cotton with brushed fleece interior. Features dropped shoulders, concealed side-seam pockets, ribbed cuffs and hem, and clean tonal silicone branding.
fields.short_description: Ultra-heavyweight 480 GSM French Terry cotton hoodie with custom tailored oversized silhouette and double-layered thermal hood.

fields.name: Executive Italian Wool Minimalist Trench Coat
fields.description: An enduring masterpiece of outerwear luxury. Constructed from premium Italian virgin wool providing exceptional warmth and natural weather resilience. Features a belted waist with leather buckle, storm flap, tailored notch lapel, and interior passport security pockets.
fields.short_description: Masterfully crafted from 100% fine Italian virgin wool with satin cupro lining and horn button fastenings.

fields.name: Techwear Waterproof Modular Windbreaker Jacket
fields.description: Engineered for extreme urban and outdoor elements. Made with high-tensile ripstop nylon membrane offering 20,000mm waterproofing and breathable vapor release. Includes concealed storm hood, waterproof YKK Aquaguard zips, and ergonomic thumbhole storm cuffs.
fields.short_description: Three-layer GORE-TEX inspired waterproof shell with taped seams, articulated sleeves, and Fidlock magnetic utility pockets.

fields.name: Luxury Pima Cotton Minimalist Crewneck T-Shirt
fields.description: The quintessential foundation of luxury everyday style. Spun from 100% extra-long staple Peruvian Pima cotton, renowned for superior softness, high durability, and pill-resistant smooth drape. Pre-shrunk and enzyme washed for an exquisite second-skin feel.
fields.short_description: Supremely soft 240 GSM Peruvian long-staple Pima cotton crewneck with silk-touch wash finish.
